instruction: How to add an SSH known hosts entry in ArgoCD
output: kubectl patch configmap argocd-ssh-known-hosts-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"ssh_known_hosts":"github.com ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAA..."}}'

instruction: How to add TLS certificates for git repos in ArgoCD
output: kubectl patch configmap argocd-tls-certs-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"git.example.com":"-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n...\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----"}}'
